## About

Parsa is a Full-Stack Software Engineer with proven experience shipping production systems across the full stack — from responsive frontends in Next.js and Tailwind CSS to distributed NestJS backends with PostgreSQL, Redis, and real-time WebSocket layers. He has led projects solo from architecture through deployment, and has collaborated on multi-developer teams using Turborepo monorepos.

He has a strong academic background in machine learning and AI, with personal projects spanning CNNs for image classification, autoencoders for anomaly detection, and PID-based neural network optimization.

Currently based in Armenia. Open to remote full-time roles and freelance contracts.

## Professional Projects

### Project Luna (Jun 2026 – Present)
**Role**: Lead Fullstack Developer  
**Stack**: NestJS, Next.js, Turborepo, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis, MinIO, Tailwind CSS  
Enterprise platform for the power industry. Features full inventory management with grid-based product browsing, a bulk ordering matrix with live tier pricing, and role-based dashboards for manufacturers, stores, and admins. Strict RBAC ensures complete isolation between user types. OTP-based authentication.  
**URL**: https://parsany.com/projects/project-luna

---

### Atrafian Chat & Social Ecosystem (Jan 2026 – Mar 2026)
**Role**: Solo Fullstack & Mobile Developer  
**Stack**: NestJS, Next.js, Socket.io, Redis, PostgreSQL, Turborepo, Capacitor.js  
A full real-time social platform built solo over 3 months. Features:
- Real-time personal, group, and support chat via Socket.io with FCM push fallback for offline users
- Stories, chat requests, media sharing (images, voice, video) via self-hosted MinIO
- Radar discovery map using a solar-system-style layout — users orbit in belts by online status and distance rather than live GPS
- Client-side NSFW detection via NSFW.js at signup with admin reporting
- Server-side illegal-word and NSFW filter layer
- Support ticketing system and wallet with payment gateway integration
- Eliminated N+1 query issues in group messaging with bulk SQL aggregations (sub-second delivery in 1,000+ user rooms)
- Mobile app built with Capacitor.js (client constraint ruled out React Native)

**Live**: https://atraf.parsany.com | **Dashboard**: https://atradmin.parsany.com  
**URL**: https://parsany.com/projects/atrafian

---

### Battery ESP / MSK E-Commerce (Dec 2025 – Jun 2026)
**Role**: Fullstack Developer (team)  
**Stack**: NestJS, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Turborepo, Tailwind CSS  
Dual-brand e-commerce platform for two battery brands (ESP and MSK) sharing one NestJS backend. Dual-language (FA/EN). Key feature: warranty verification — customers enter a serial number, validated against a DB of pre-generated keys.  
**Live Demo**: https://epweb.parsany.com | **Dashboard**: https://edash.parsany.com  
**URL**: https://parsany.com/projects/esp

---

### Goldenbat GPS Tracking (Sep 2024 – Jan 2025)
**Role**: Frontend Developer (team)  
**Stack**: Next.js, tRPC, Mapbox, PostgreSQL  
Live fleet tracking dashboard for a GPS hardware company. Backend ingests 10,000+ GPS coordinate updates/minute with sub-second latency. Dashboard shows live vehicle positions, historical paths, geofencing alerts. Built the landing page, mobile PWA, and contributed to the fleet dashboard — including geofencing UI and notification system.  
**Live Demo**: https://gbat.parsany.com  
**URL**: https://parsany.com/projects/goldenbat

## Academic & Personal Projects

### Cat Emotion Recognition
CNN trained to classify cat emotions. Last updated Aug 2025 with accuracy improved to 70%.  
**GitHub**: https://github.com/parsany/CatRecognition

### Anomaly Detection for Goldmines
Deep learning models using various Autoencoder architectures (including VAE) for mineral zone (anomaly) detection in geological data.  
**GitHub**: https://github.com/parsany/anomaly-VAE

### Conway Invaders
Space Invaders where enemies are Conway's Game of Life cellular automata. Playable at https://parsany.com/game  
**GitHub**: https://github.com/parsany/Conway-game-of-life-invaders

### PID_NN
PID control applied to optimize neural network training dynamics.  
**GitHub**: https://github.com/parsany/PID_NN

### Library Program QT
Desktop library manager built with PyQt — a personal tool replacing Calibre's UI.  
**GitHub**: https://github.com/parsany/PyLibrary-QT

### Simple Interpreter with Flex & Bison
University compiler construction project — a working interpreter built with Flex (lexer) and Bison (parser).  
**GitHub**: https://github.com/parsany/InterpreterFlexBison
